problem.title: Determine Whether Three Keys in a Binary Search Tree Sum to a Given Value
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree and an integer K, determine whether there exist three distinct nodes whose values sum to K.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the BST. • The last line contains K.
problem.output: • Print YES if such a triplet exists; otherwise print NO.
